posts.title: Executing AI agent on behalf another user in LangSmith Agent Builder (Resolved)
posts.description: This post examines the agent's underlying architecture and the chain of vulnerabilities that led to user impersonation during agent execution.

posts.title: Chaining service key leakage and path confusion in LangSmith (Resolved)
posts.description: This post describes the discovery and exploitation of a vulnerability that allowed unauthorised access across LangSmith agent deployments. In addition, it details research into path normalisation differences between Nginx and GCP Load Balancer.

posts.title: Achieving remote code execution in LangSmith Playground using unsafe template formatting
posts.description: This post details the discovery and exploitation of a vulnerability in LangSmith Playground that allowed arbitrary code execution through unsafe template formatting.
